title: Activating the Annotator: Operationalising Lived Experience in Data Annotation
abstract: arXiv:2610.12701v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Perspectivist NLP has established that annotator positionality shapes labels for subjective tasks, but the field still lacks methods for operationalising it. Positionality is typically operationalised as a demographic form completed at recruitment: a static attribute recorded once and treated as a covariate, on the assumption that the knowledge it indexes is active when the annotator reads an item. This paper treats that assumption as a design problem and asks whether lived experience can instead be primed by the task itself. We introduce AXLE, a pre-annotation stage in which a scenario vignette anchors a short, axis-guided conversation that is synthesised into a first-person micro-narrative and returned to the annotator before labelling begins. translated_title: 激活标注者：在数据标注中操作化生活经验
translated_abstract: 视角主义NLP（Perspectivist NLP）已经证实，标注者的位置性会塑造主观任务的标签，但该领域仍然缺乏将其操作化的方法。位置性通常被操作化为招募时填写的一份人口统计表：一个仅记录一次的静态属性，并被当作协变量处理，其背后的假设是它所索引的知识在标注者阅读条目时是活跃的。本文将这一假设视为一个设计问题，并追问生活经验是否可以改由任务本身来激活。我们提出了AXLE——一个标注前阶段，其中一个情境小场景锚定一段简短的、由轴引导的对话，该对话被合成为第一人称微型叙事，并在标注开始前呈现给标注者。在一项针对涵盖移民、宗教与性别议题的模糊仇恨言论的2×2被试间研究（104名标注者、30个条目、1040条标注）中，经验激发与更高的身份相关性相关……（原文摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出AXLE——一种标注前阶段，通过情境小场景引导对话并将其合成为第一人称微型叙事，在标注开始前激活标注者的生活经验，从而将位置性从静态的人口统计学属性转变为可由任务本身激发的动态资源，并证实其对模糊仇恨言论的标注产生了影响。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AXLE, a pre-annotation stage that anchors axis-guided conversations in scenario vignettes, synthesises them into first-person micro-narratives, and returns them to annotators before labelling, thereby priming lived experience dynamically instead of treating positionality as a static demographic covariate, with effects shown on annotating ambiguous hate speech.
